cores.description: Number of CPU cores to use. Set to 0 for auto-detect.

block_fraction.description: Block size relative to LZMA dictionary size.

queue_size.description: Number of blocks in compression queue. Set to 0 for default calculation.

extract_path.description: Path prefix for extraction. Empty if not extracting.

input_path.description: Input file path. Empty if using stdin.

output_path.description: Output file path. Empty if using stdout or auto.
